question: A and B start running on a circular race track whose length is 3240 m. A and B start from the same point and at the same time, but in opposite directions. If A runs at a speed of 10 m/s and they cross each other 3 minutes after they start running, then what is B's speed (in m/s)?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the circular track = 3240 m

Speed of A (VA) = 10 m/s

Time until they cross each other (t) = 3 minutes

**Concept Used:**

When two objects move in opposite directions on a circular track and meet for the first time,

The total distance covered by them collectively is equal to the length of the track.

The relative speed when moving in opposite directions is the sum of their individual speeds.
